entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. We’ll turn the nobles' suspicion into complacency, make them believe they’re still in control while we work behind the scenes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "What if we use the royal houses’ suspicions to our advantage? Let them think they’re on to something. Feed them false information and lead them down the wrong path."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You convinced me, Manus. We'll do..."
entries.dialogueText: "You convinced me, Manus. We'll do it your way."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Clever, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Sounds risky. But it could be a cl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds risky. But it could be a clever strategy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. I will ensure we don'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I will ensure we don't raise any suspicions. I will make sure that every detail of the celebration is meticulously planned."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Of course, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't think it will work. I need..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think it will work. I need you to trust me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why wouldn't you want a direct sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why wouldn't you want a direct solution to these reforms you wanted so badly? Or do you not really care about them as you claim to do?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty. Violence is not the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Violence is not the solution. We can still implement these reforms without the nobility. We have the backing of the people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you want this constitution impl..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want this constitution implemented, you *will* listen to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need you to make sure your House..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need you to make sure your House is fully behind us and that it doesn't try anything funny. Do you hear me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for everything you've do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for everything you've done so far, Manus. But you must leave this final part to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promise you, Manus. Nobody will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise you, Manus. Nobody will get hurt. I just need you to trust me on this."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But...""

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't repeat myself.""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't repeat myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I waited for him to respond."
entries.dialogueText: I waited for him to respond.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The people will be counting on you.""
entries.dialogueText: "The people will be counting on you."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""What exactly are you implying? Are..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly are you implying? Are you suggesting someone like the Golden Guard be deployed against the other Houses?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've heard me, Manus. Please don..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've heard me, Manus. Please don't make this difficult."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Like I said, you don't need to wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like I said, you don't need to worry about the details."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for preparing everything..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for preparing everything so far, Manus. But let me handle the rest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you warned me against Titus..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you warned me against Titus, but I trust him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sticking to the plan. If you'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sticking to the plan. If you're really afraid to experience how I handle this first-hand, don't attend the gathering. It's up to you."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The time has come to discuss our f..."
entries.dialogueText: "The time has come to discuss our final steps. We'll soon have a meeting with the Royal Houses to get their support for our proposal."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The Queen Mother’s birthday coinci..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Queen Mother’s birthday coinciding with the reforms wasn't intentional by any means. However, all three royal houses, along with their most influential leaders, will gather here to pay their respects to Queen Estela..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""...And use this opportunity to rai..."
entries.dialogueText: "...And use this opportunity to raise their concerns about the proposed reforms."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "We must be willing to compromise when it comes down to it."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're nothing like what I expecte..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're nothing like what I expected."

entries.title: Narrator: "It hadn't been very long since I'd..."
entries.dialogueText: It hadn't been very long since I'd seen Adarfo at the House of Delegates. Still, the RPP speaker looked even more rugged than I remembered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Seeing him up close, I noticed the..."
entries.dialogueText: Seeing him up close, I noticed the scar that cut across his nose. With his his unkempt beard, and the rugged, olive-green coat -- all of it seemed more fitting for a man of the streets than the polished halls of politics.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The cries of the people may be lou..."
entries.dialogueText: "The cries of the people may be loud, but governing requires more than just responding to the noise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand your commitment, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your commitment, but you must understand mine as well. My aim is to ensure stability while implementing these reforms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't like your attitude, Mr. So..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't like your attitude, Mr. Sotelato. I advise you to choose your words carefully."

entries.dialogueText: "That’s why I’m here. I’m willing to work with you, but it must be as equals."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Governing also requires listening,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Governing also requires listening, Your Majesty. The cries of the people aren't noise -- they’re a warning."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And I ask of you to consider why m..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I ask of you to consider why my attitude is as it is, Your Majesty. I’m not here to placate or to play politics. I’m here because the people demand change."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I will not betray their trust by t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not betray their trust by tempering my words. We can work together, or we can oppose each other. I will not compromise the truth of what needs to be done.”

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""But if you don't take decisive act..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if you don't take decisive action, Your Majesty, the result will be complete and utter chaos."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Despite our differences, I believe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite our differences, I believe we both want what’s best for Rizia."
